Method.name: ping
Method.Description: This request returns a reply message in response to a /ping request.
Method.Implementation:
set ^webService("ping") = "Start "_ $ZDATETIME($HOROLOG,3, 1) Do ..%SetStatusCode(200) Set cm = { "Name": "TpManage.impl", "CommunicationContact": "Jay", "BusinessContact ": "1234", "Folder": "J@imail.org", "Type": "Test" } Do ..%SetHeader("Ping", "OK")
Quit cm

Method.name: CopyToTpIdFromJSON
Method.Implementation:
Set tpNm =obj.Name set tradingPartnerId = "" set ^webService("TpIdsForTP Parent ") = tpNm &SQL(select ID into :tradingPartnerId FROM IHC_ERP_TPManage.TradingPartner where Name = :tpNm) if SQLCODE '= 0 { set tSC = $$$ERROR($$$EnsErrGeneral, "Error in finding TP: " _ SQLCODE) return tSC } if (tradingPartnerId = "") { set tSC = $$$ERROR($$$EnsErrGeneral, "ID for TP is empty " _ tpNm) return tSC
}
set ^webService("TpIdsForTP Parent ") = tradingPartnerId Set cm.TPID = obj.TPID
#dim tp As IHC.ERP.TPManage.TradingPartner set tp = ##class(IHC.ERP.TPManage.TradingPartner).%OpenId(tradingPartnerId) set cm.TPFK = tp set cm.Type = obj.Type
set dtTm = $ZDATETIME($HOROLOG,3, 1) set cm.CreatedDtTM = dtTm set cm.LastmodDtTM = dtTm set cm.LastmodID = obj.User set cm.CreateID = obj.User
return $$$OK
